title: State of Karnataka v. Manjunath & Ors. (Indiranagar Robbery-Homicide)
confidence_note: High (Direct latent fingerprint match and gold jewellery recovery under Sec 27 Evidence Act)

ground_truth.culprit_summary: Former domestic assistant Manjunath and accomplice
ground_truth.rationale: Latent fingerprint on broken window latch matched Manjunath; stolen 120g temple gold recovered from pawn broker based on disclosure.

hypotheses.label: Former Domestic Staff Manjunath
hypotheses.statement: Former domestic worker Manjunath knew the safe combination, broke through the rear window, and assaulted the resident.

hypotheses.label: Local Gang Break-In
hypotheses.statement: An opportunistic neighborhood gang broke in randomly through the unlocked rear terrace.

hypotheses.label: Family Dispute / Staged Robbery
hypotheses.statement: An estranged relative staged the burglary to seize property deeds and ancestral gold.

exhibits.name: Fingerprint Bureau Latent Print Lift on Window Latch
exhibits.text: Eight ridge characteristics lifted from glass pane and aluminum latch of rear ground-floor window matched right index finger of Manjunath (AFIS score 98.4%).

exhibits.name: Residential Street CCTV Camera Feed
exhibits.text: Neighbor's Dahua IP camera captures two individuals wearing helmets entering lane at 02:14 AM and leaving at 02:49 AM on a black motorcycle with obscured plates.

exhibits.name: Pawnshop Recovery Memo under Sec 27 Evidence Act
exhibits.text: Recovery of 120 grams of melted temple design gold necklace from Sri Balaji Bankers pawnshop pursuant to voluntary disclosure statement of Manjunath.

exhibits.name: Witness Statement of Security Guard
exhibits.text: Private security guard on duty reported hearing a loud thud around 02:30 AM but thought it was stray cats knocked off the parapet.

adversarial_exhibit.name: Anonymous Tip accusing Neighboring Relative
adversarial_exhibit.text: Unsigned letter dropped in police complaint box claiming the victim's nephew was seen arguing on the veranda that afternoon.
